title: Guide: VTC implementer's guide to FileNode
description: Write jmap-vtc-filenode-guide.md for VTC implementers adding file sharing during calls. Covers: sharing files in-call via JMAP FileNode through the bound Chat, screen-shared content as FileNode references, recording blobs as FileNode entries for organized post-call access, shared whiteboard/document references, permission model (who can share files during a call), file size limits and upload progress during calls.
